Job Description:

The Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) is responsible for ensuring the continuous monitoring of security and privacy controls for one or more information systems managed by or on behalf our Federal civilian agency customer. The ISSO works closely with the Information System Owner, Information System Security Manager, system administrators, and other IT and privacy professionals supporting the system(s). The position shall have the detailed knowledge and expertise required to manage the security aspects of an information system and is assigned responsibility for the day-to-day security monitoring of the system(s), including but not limited to threat analysis, vulnerability assessments and remediation, compliance monitoring and reporting, POAM and Corrective Action Plan management, Interconnection Security Agreements, Security Impact Assessments within the change management process, risk assessments, and SLAs. Security controls and standards are aligned with NIST SP 800-53 rev 5 and the NIST RMF.

Requires in-depth knowledge of FISMA, FedRAMP, NIST Special, Risk Management Framework, POAM management, incident response, audit, accreditation processes, and configuration management compliance.

Additional activities include:

  • Develop and/or maintain physical or logical topologies for monitored system(s) in concert with systems engineers

  • Assist the contract’s security manager in meeting their duties and responsibilities, as well as extensive collaboration with customer security personnel

  • Prepare, review, and update authorization packages and associated artifacts; familiarity with an authorization management system such as JCAM, eMASS, CSAM, Xacta, etc.

  • Ensure the contract’s operations procedures and process documents are properly managed and reviewed/updated at least annually.

  • Conduct periodic reviews of information systems to ensure compliance with the security authorization package.

  • Coordinate annual incident management and COOP/DR tabletop exercises; monitor system recovery processes to ensure security features and procedures are properly restored and functioning correctly.

  • Familiarity with Azure tools, particularly Defender and Sentinel are highly desirable.

  • Ensure audit records are collected, reviewed, and documented (to include any anomalies), in addition to internal and external audit support

Experience:

  • Prior performance in roles such as System Administrator or Network Administrator, with preferential experience in specific ISSO duties.

Certifications: CISSP or Security+ any revelant IT or security certification

Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree OR industry recognized certifications and 8 years of relevant experience

The likely salary range for this position is $125,800 - $170,200. This is not, however, a guarantee of compensation or salary. Rather, salary will be set based on experience, geographic location and possibly contractual requirements and could fall outside of this range.

About Winning Assistants

Winning Assistants is one of the fastest-growing offshore staffing companies helping doctors, clinic owners, and healthcare businesses scale with highly trained virtual assistants.

We help healthcare practices save time, streamline operations, reduce payroll costs, improve patient experience, and grow faster through elite remote talent.

We are aggressively scaling our paid advertising efforts and currently spend over $100,000/month on META Ads, with plans to continue increasing spend.

We are looking for a high-level Senior Media Buyer who deeply understands Meta Ads, conversion psychology, creative strategy, funnel optimization, and performance marketing.

This is NOT an entry-level role.

We are looking for someone obsessed with performance, data, testing, scaling, and booked calls.

Your Main Goal

Your primary objective is simple:

Generate qualified booked calls profitably through Meta Ads.

You will be responsible for helping us scale ad spend while maintaining strong performance metrics across the entire funnel.

This means understanding:

  • CTR
  • Hook rate
  • Thumbstop ratio
  • CPC
  • CPM
  • Landing page conversion rate
  • Cost per lead
  • Cost per booked call
  • Show rates
  • Lead quality
  • Sales conversion quality
  • Funnel bottlenecks
  • Creative fatigue
  • Scaling strategy

You should understand that media buying is NOT just “launching ads.”

You must understand how the:

  • ad creative,
  • audience,
  • offer,
  • landing page,
  • tracking,
  • qualification process,
  • and sales process

all work together.

Responsibilities

Meta Ads Management

  • Launch, manage, and optimize Meta ad campaigns daily
  • Manage campaigns spending thousands per day
  • Scale winning campaigns aggressively while maintaining efficiency
  • Monitor ad account health and performance
  • Test new campaign structures, audiences, and scaling methods
  • Analyze performance trends and identify bottlenecks quickly
  • Reduce CPA and improve overall funnel efficiency

Creative Strategy & Testing

You will work closely with our creative/content team.

Responsibilities include:

  • Identifying winning ad angles
  • Suggesting new hooks and messaging
  • Researching competitors
  • Analyzing winning creatives
  • Identifying creative fatigue early
  • Structuring creative testing systems
  • Giving feedback to editors/content creators
  • Understanding different audience awareness levels

You should know how messaging changes depending on audience sophistication and awareness.

Funnel & Landing Page Optimization

You must deeply understand landing page performance.

This role is NOT limited to ad management.

You should be able to analyze:

  • Why some ads have high CTR but poor conversion
  • Why some ads bring low-quality leads
  • Why landing pages underperform
  • How messaging alignment impacts conversion rates
  • How qualification impacts lead quality

You will continuously work on improving:

  • Landing page CVR
  • Funnel flow
  • Form completion rate
  • Appointment booking rate
  • Lead quality

Tracking & Attribution

You must understand:

  • Hyros
  • Meta Pixel
  • UTM tracking
  • Attribution windows
  • Conversion API (CAPI)
  • Funnel tracking systems

You should be highly analytical and obsessed with understanding:

“Where are our best booked calls actually coming from?”

Data Analysis & Reporting

  • Monitor KPIs daily
  • Create performance insights and recommendations
  • Identify scaling opportunities
  • Spot inefficiencies quickly
  • Report findings clearly to leadership

You should be comfortable making decisions backed by data.

Requirements

MUST HAVE:

  • Proven experience managing Meta Ads at a high level
  • Experience generating booked calls (NOT just leads)
  • Strong understanding of direct response marketing
  • Strong understanding of conversion-focused funnels
  • Strong understanding of Meta Ads Manager
  • Strong communication skills
  • Strong analytical thinking
  • Ability to move fast and execute
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

HUGE PLUS IF YOU HAVE:

  • Experience with high-ticket service businesses
  • Experience with Hyros
  • Experience scaling campaigns past $50k/month ad spend
  • Experience improving landing page conversion rates
  • Experience working with creative teams
  • Experience inside agencies

What We’re Looking For

We are NOT looking for:

  • someone who just boosts posts
  • someone who relies only on broad targeting without strategy
  • someone who waits days to make decisions
  • someone who only understands surface-level metrics

We ARE looking for:

  • someone proactive
  • someone obsessed with performance
  • someone analytical
  • someone competitive
  • someone who loves scaling
  • someone who thinks like an operator, not just an employee

Compensation

  • Competitive monthly salary
  • Performance-based incentives available
  • Long-term growth opportunity
  • Potential leadership opportunity as the marketing team expands

Work Setup

  • Full-Time
  • Remote
  • Philippines preferred
  • Must have reliable internet and equipment
  • Must be highly responsive during working hours (California - Pacific Standard Time)

To Apply

Please send:

  1. Your resume
  2. Case studies/results/screenshots

Using Loom.com, please record yourself answering the following questions and send us the video link once completed:

  1. Walk us through a Meta Ads campaign you personally scaled successfully. Please include:
    • Starting ad spend vs. scaled ad spend
    • Industry/niche
    • Main objective (booked calls, purchases, etc.)
    • KPIs before vs. after scaling
    • Specific optimizations you implemented
    • The biggest bottleneck you encountered and how you solved it
  2. What is your creative testing process?
  3. What is your scaling process?
  4. When optimizing campaigns for booked calls, what metrics matter most to you and why?
  5. Have you used Hyros before? If yes, please explain:
    • What you used it for
    • How it improved your campaign performance and tracking

Please note that the video submission is a very important part of the application process. Applications submitted without a video link will not be considered.

We look forward to reviewing your responses!

We are looking for A-players only.
